snippet.title: Compacted: A slot-machine roguelite where every spin is a fight for survival.
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4453280/Compacted

Your debt is crushing you. Literally.

Compacted is a slot-machine roguelite where every spin costs precious space. Earn gold, gain experience, reduce your debt and force back the walls before they close around you.

Each run revolves around five symbols. Level up to upgrade them, choose items that reshape your strategy and combine their effects into increasingly powerful builds. Landing three matching symbols triggers a jackpot, producing effects that can multiply rewards, reduce debt or buy you enough room to survive another round.

Randomness determines what appears, but your decisions determine whether it works. Balance immediate survival against long-term growth, decide which symbols deserve upgrades and adapt your strategy before the lender’s demands become impossible to meet.

Every stage introduces a new lender and a larger debt. Fail to repay them before the walls close, and the rules of the Lenders Association are simple:
You get compacted.
